subject: social_science

concepts.title: Area of Jurisdiction of a Police Station
concepts.definition: The defined geographic territory assigned to a specific police post, within which officers are authorised to register and investigate complaints.
concepts.key_idea: Every police station has a designated geographic boundary for reporting and investigating local cases.
question_patterns: what is the jurisdiction area of a local police station
explain why a crime must be reported to the designated police station
identify which police station holds authority over a specific village
describe the administrative boundaries of police jurisdiction
determine where a citizen should file a complaint regarding local theft

solution_steps.action: identify the locality where the incident took place
solution_steps.explain: Each village or town area falls strictly under the territorial jurisdiction of one specific police station.

solution_steps.action: locate the designated police station for that area
solution_steps.explain: Complaints can only be officially registered and investigated by the police station responsible for that specified zone.

concepts.title: Role and Work at the Police Station
concepts.section: The work at the Police Station
concepts.definition: The official duties of police personnel and the Station House Officer, including logging written complaints, investigating offenses, and preserving peace.
concepts.key_idea: The Station House Officer records written complaints and dispatches officers to investigate reported incidents.
question_patterns: what is the primary responsibility of the Station House Officer
describe the procedure for registering a written complaint at a police station
explain how police investigate local disputes and maintain law and order
list the main duties performed by police station staff
outline the steps an S.H.O. takes upon receiving an injury report

solution_steps.action: file a formal written complaint with the Station House Officer
solution_steps.explain: The S.H.O. receives the statement of the victim or witness and records the First Information Report or written complaint.
A constable or officer is dispatched to the location of the dispute to gather evidence and record statements.

concepts.title: Role and Duties of the Patwari
concepts.definition: A local administrative official tasked with measuring land plots, maintaining ownership registers, and updating village maps.
concepts.key_idea: The Patwari measures land plots, keeps records updated, and assists in land revenue collection for a cluster of villages.
question_patterns: what are the main responsibilities of a Patwari in a village
explain how a Patwari measures agricultural land and updates records
list alternative local names used for the Patwari in different states
describe how the Patwari assists in land revenue collection
identify who maintains field boundaries and ownership maps in rural areas

solution_steps.action: measure agricultural fields using measuring chains or instruments
solution_steps.explain: The Patwari verifies boundary markers against existing official maps to detect land encroachments.

solution_steps.action: update land revenue and ownership documents
solution_steps.explain: Changes in ownership, crop patterns, or construction of wells are recorded in government registers.

concepts.title: Khasra Records and Land Maps
concepts.definition: A official village register kept by land officials detailing individual plot numbers, owners, area sizes, crop types, and irrigation sources.
concepts.key_idea: Khasra records provide accurate tabular details that correspond directly to village land maps.
question_patterns: what information is recorded in a Khasra register
explain how a Khasra record helps settle field boundary disputes
identify details stored regarding crop cultivation and irrigation facilities
describe why farmers require official copies of Khasra maps
analyze how land ownership details are mapped and documented

solution_steps.action: match the plot number on the map with the entry in the Khasra table
solution_steps.explain: The Khasra number links spatial map boundaries with legal ownership records.

solution_steps.action: verify ownership, cultivated area, and crop entries
solution_steps.explain: This official entry establishes legal title, crop types, and boundary specifications.

concepts.title: Structure and Role of the Revenue Department
concepts.definition: The government administrative hierarchy headed by the District Collector and Tehsildars that oversees land record management and resolves property disputes.
concepts.key_idea: Tehsildars supervise Patwaris, resolve land disputes, collect revenue, and issue essential government certificates.
question_patterns: what is the role of a Tehsildar in rural administration
explain the relationship between the District Collector and revenue officers
describe how Tehsildars supervise the work of village Patwaris
identify where land ownership disputes are formally heard and resolved
list the certificates and documents issued by the revenue department office

solution_steps.action: supervise Patwari records at the Tehsil level
solution_steps.explain: Tehsildars ensure accurate land entry maintenance and collection of government land revenue.

solution_steps.action: hear legal land disputes and issue certificates
solution_steps.explain: The Tehsildar court resolves property conflicts and issues official caste and land certificates.

concepts.title: Equal Land Share Calculation under Hindu Succession Amendment Act, 2005
concepts.definition: The mathematical division of inherited ancestral land equally among all eligible legal heirs, including sons, daughters, and mother, under legal reform guidelines.
concepts.key_idea: The total agricultural land is divided equally among all eligible heirs.
question_patterns: calculate the equal land share allocated to each family member
find the area of inherited land received per heir
determine how much agricultural land each child and mother gets
what is the individual share when dividing family property equally
compute the land portion for an heir from the total ancestral field

solution_steps.action: divide total land area by the total number of heirs
solution_steps.explain: Under the amended law, all heirs receive an equal fraction of the ancestral land.

concepts.title: Equal Rights under Hindu Succession Amendment Act, 2005
concepts.definition: A legal reform that ensures sons, daughters, and mothers possess identical ownership rights in ancestral family agricultural land.
concepts.key_idea: The 2005 amendment removed gender discrimination in the inheritance of family agricultural land.
question_patterns: what changes were introduced by the Hindu Succession Amendment Act of 2005
explain how the 2005 law empowers rural women regarding land ownership
describe the legal rights of daughters and mothers in family property
compare agricultural land inheritance rules before and after 2005
evaluate the impact of equal land rights on female financial security

solution_steps.action: identify legal beneficiaries under the 2005 Act
solution_steps.explain: The law includes sons, daughters, and mothers as equal legal heirs to family property.

solution_steps.action: apply equal rights to land records
solution_steps.explain: The Patwari enters names of female family members along with male heirs in official land records.

concepts.title: Public Services and Local Amenities in Rural Areas
concepts.definition: Government facilities and local civic administration networks, such as fair price shops, healthcare centers, and milk cooperatives, serving rural citizens.
concepts.key_idea: Government departments manage essential public facilities that require civic monitoring and continuous improvement.
question_patterns: list essential public services available in rural villages
explain the function of a fair price shop or ration store
describe problems faced by villagers when accessing public amenities
identify government institutions that provide health and credit services in villages
suggest improvements for effective delivery of public services in rural areas

solution_steps.action: identify public infrastructure operating in rural areas
solution_steps.explain: Facilities include fair price ration shops, primary health centres, banks, and post offices.

solution_steps.action: assess operational efficiency and citizen access
solution_steps.explain: Citizens access services using official cards or documents, while authorities address supply and quality issues.

worked_examples.question_pattern: A farmer leaves {total_land} hectares of land to be divided equally among {total_heirs} heirs. Calculate the share of land each heir receives.

solution_template.action: divide total land by total number of heirs
solution_template.explain: Divide the total land area equally among all legal heirs.

worked_examples.question_pattern: Determine the land area received by each family member if {total_land} acres of field are distributed equally among {total_heirs} legal beneficiaries.

solution_template.action: divide total land area by count of beneficiaries
solution_template.explain: Divide the total plot area equally among all legal beneficiaries.
